notes: Read all 58 source lines with a numbered view before editing.
L1 `import { useCallback, useState } from 'react'`: preserved (both RN-compatible); native additionally pulls in useEffect + useRef to clean up the copied-reset timer on unmount.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'`: react-i18next has no provider in the native parity tree; replaced by the shared `useNativeTranslationFallback` -> NativeTFunction(key, fallback) returning the English fallback. All five t() keys/fallbacks are copied verbatim.

L3 `import { Check, Link2 } from 'lucide-react'`: lucide is DOM/SVG-only (contract rule 4). Mapped to the native SemanticIcon glyph table: `Link2` -> name='link' (glyph LN, accent), `Check` -> name='confirm' (glyph OK, success). Same default-link / copied-check intent.

L4 `import { Button } from '../ui/Button'`: the web ghost+sm Button becomes a ghost Pressable + AppText (no web UI components in native output, contract rule 4); styling reproduced in styles.button (transparent, content-sized via alignSelf flex-start, minHeight 32 = h-8, gap = gap-2, paddingHorizontal = px-3).

L5 `import { useToast } from '../feedback/Toast'`: the web Toast context throws without a ToastProvider and is DOM/framer-motion based; replaced by the optional `onToast(kind, message)` host bridge prop. The in-button icon+label swap still provides visible feedback even when no bridge is wired.
L6 blank line: preserved as spacing between imports and the component.

L7-16 component JSDoc (copies current URL path+query for sharing a filtered/deep-linked view; pair with useUrlState; use sparingly): preserved + adapted into the file header and the CopyLinkButton doc comment, documenting the native unavailable state and the url/onCopy/onToast host bridges.

L17 `export function CopyLinkButton()`: named export preserved exactly (web is prop-less). Native adds all-optional props (url/onCopy/onToast/style/testID) so `<CopyLinkButton />` still compiles and renders the disabled unavailable state.
L18 `const { t } = useTranslation()`: replaced by `const t = useNativeTranslationFallback()`.
L19 `const toast = useToast()`: replaced by the `onToast` prop (host feedback bridge); see L5.
L20 `const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)`: preserved verbatim.
L21 blank line: preserved.
L22 `const handleClick = useCallback(async () => {`: preserved as `handlePress` (RN onPress naming); still an async useCallback.

L23 `if (typeof window === 'undefined') return`: the SSR/no-window guard becomes the native availability guard — `if (!available || url == null || onCopy == null) return`, where `available = url is a non-empty string && onCopy != null` (no host link/writer === the unavailable state).

L24 `const url = window.location.href`: window.location does not exist natively; the value-to-copy now comes from the `url` prop (host-supplied current-view deep link). See L23 guard + the `url` prop doc.
L25 `try {`: preserved.

L26 `if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {`: navigator.clipboard is browser-only; the capability check collapses into the single `onCopy` host writer path (its presence is already asserted by `available`).
L27 `await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url)`: replaced by `await onCopy(url)` — the host clipboard writer (e.g. @react-native-clipboard/clipboard / expo-clipboard).

L28-38 `else { ... textarea + document.execCommand('copy') fallback ... }` (createElement/appendChild/select/execCommand/removeChild): DOM-only legacy clipboard fallback with no native analogue (contract rule 7); dropped — `onCopy` is the single native write path and any host-side fallback lives behind it.
L39 `setCopied(true)`: preserved verbatim.
L40 `toast.success(t('common.copyLink.success', 'Link copied to clipboard'))`: replaced by `onToast?.('success', t('common.copyLink.success', 'Link copied to clipboard'))`; key + fallback verbatim.

L41 `window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)`: preserved as `setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), COPIED_RESET_MS)` with COPIED_RESET_MS = 2000; tracked in resetRef and cleared via clearReset() before re-arming and on unmount (useEffect cleanup) to avoid setState-after-unmount / open handles.
L42 `} catch {`: preserved verbatim.
L43 `toast.error(t('common.copyLink.error', 'Could not copy link'))`: replaced by `onToast?.('error', t('common.copyLink.error', 'Could not copy link'))`; key + fallback verbatim.
L44 `}` (close try/catch): preserved.
L45 `}, [toast, t])`: preserved as the handlePress useCallback dependency list, adapted to the native deps [available, url, onCopy, onToast, t, clearReset].
L46 blank line: preserved.
L47 `return (`: preserved.

L48-50 `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" ...>`: -> a ghost `<Pressable>` (accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityState={disabled:!available}, disabled, hitSlop, onPress=handlePress) with styles.button + styles.buttonPressed (surfaceRaised on press, ghost hover parity) + styles.buttonDisabled (opacity-50 = web disabled:opacity-50).

L51 `icon={copied ? <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <Link2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}`: -> `<SemanticIcon decorative name={copied ? 'confirm' : 'link'} size="sm" style={styles.icon} />` (size sm ~ h-3.5; borderWidth 0 removes the glyph box border so it reads as a bare icon).
L52 `onClick={handleClick}`: -> `onPress={handlePress}` on the Pressable.
L53 `aria-label={t('common.copyLink.label', 'Copy link to this view')}`: -> `accessibilityLabel={t('common.copyLink.label', 'Copy link to this view')}`; key + fallback verbatim.
L54 `>`: preserved (Pressable open-tag close).

L55 `{copied ? t('common.copyLink.copied', 'Copied') : t('common.copyLink.action', 'Copy link')}`: -> the `label` const rendered inside `<AppText variant="caption" weight="semibold" style={styles.label}>` (textSecondary, ~text-xs); both keys + fallbacks verbatim.
L56 `</Button>`: -> `</Pressable>` close.
L57 `}`: function close preserved; CopyLinkButton.displayName='CopyLinkButton' added (parity-tree convention).
L58 trailing newline: preserved.

No DOM (window/navigator/document), react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web-UI (../ui/Button, ../feedback/Toast) imports remain; only RN primitives (Pressable/StyleSheet) + native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens.
